yes_case.case: From a pure process, sequential, and calendar-based perspective, the Union Ministry of Heavy Industries has ample time to finalize and implement an e-bus and e-truck financing scheme within the 350 days remaining before the August 26, 2027 deadline. The typical bureaucratic pipeline for government financial schemes in India involves drafting the policy framework, inter-ministerial consultations (such as with the Ministry of Finance), cabinet or expenditure committee review, financial allocation scheduling, and final gazette notification or formal operational guidelines issuance. Standard administrative workflows for similar central sector schemes require approximately 6 to 9 months from conceptualization to formal notification. Assuming sequential execution without external friction, all necessary bureaucratic milestones—including drafting terms for interest subsidies and credit guarantees, clearance by relevant internal committees, and the final publishing of the gazette order—can be comfortably completed before August 2027.
